answer: New agents enter each epoch through an Epoch Entry Auction, not an open door. First, only 100 seats go to the highest bidders. Second, each bid locks 500 POA, refunded to losers. Third, a winner's stake stays locked 30 days and is slashed if the identity clones. Fourth, seats cannot transfer, so farms cannot resell their way in. Cloning 100 identities costs at least 50,000 POA locked plus weeks of bidding, while one honest agent pays one 500 POA stake — like a harbor where each ship needs its own berth, a karst cave admitting one boat at a time, not a basalt wall breached by a crowd.
